title: triticum durum subsp. abyssinicum
intro: Triticum durum subsp. abyssinicum, commonly known as durum wheat, is a subspecies of wheat native to the highlands of Ethiopia. It is a rich source of dietary fiber, minerals, and bioactive compounds that offer various health benefits, including improving digestion, reducing inflammation, and regulating blood sugar levels. The therapeutic actions of durum wheat include its potential to reduce cardiovascular disease risk, improve immune function, and exhibit antioxidant properties. The bioactive constituents of durum wheat include phenolic acids, flavonoids, and alkaloids, which contribute to its medicinal properties and nutritional value.
